text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan tells Al-Qods committee "we want land against peace, we are committed to secure Israel's security if it returns our land".
- Burundi and Cape Verde to withdraw recognition for Polisario Front in 17-year conflict with Morocco over Western Sahara.
- King Hassan presides over cabinet meeting and approves laws shaping next elections.
- King Hassan tells Jerusalem Committeee Palestinian people have rights that cannot be denied.
- Al-qods committee prepares counter offensive to Israeli expansion in East Jerusalem.
- Survey commissioned by interior ministry to define reasons preventing more foreign investments say red tape and slow judiciary proceedings are to blame.
- Despite anti-smoking law, state-owned Regie des Tabacs makes profits.
